about_the_game:
Wicked Seed blends survival horror elements with an action turn-based combat system.

In the demo for Wicked Seed you will explore the forest outskirts of a small city in Maine as you look for your estranged brother.

Move, block, parry and dodge enemy attacks in real time. Time slows as you queue up your attacks with each subsequent action being stronger than the last. Just make sure to give yourself enough time to get out of harm's way.

Explore off the beaten path and find unique items and upgrades. Decipher hints in notes to solve puzzles and optional tasks.

Earn XP by killing enemies, exploring new locations, solving puzzles, finding new items, and more to increase your strength. Find new weapons, armor, and accessories to customize your build and playstyle. 

Survive in style with costumes all completely obtainable through in-game exploration and achievements. The demo showcases 11 of the over 30 costumes that will be available in the full game.

  • Unique blend of action and turn-based RPG mechanics with a high skill ceiling

  • Exploration is always rewarding as it leads to new equipment and permanent stat boosts

  • All weapons are viable allowing you to use what you want. Power them up through an upgrade system and customize them further using weapon parts

  • 11 costumes to acquire in the demo

  • Experience the first two chapters in the demo and get introduced to the combat system

  • Demo features each weapon type and 3 of the 12 weapons from the full game

  • In-game achievements and challenges can be completed to purchase new costumes and items for the current and future playthroughs

content_descriptors.notes:
Violent and bloody imagery can be found throughout the environments including dismemberment.

Attacking and killing enemies show blood.

Some of the costumes are revealing.

There is occasional swearing.
